I'm looking at a deployment modal for a service that shows available commits to deploy. The highlighted commit is edf62a9 with a chore note about SES, followed by other commits including one for P0 auth certification and several related to payment infrastructure—this appears to be the ivx-hold service.

The timestamp at the bottom shows this was deployed very recently on July 23, 2026 at 11:20 PM, which matches the current dashboard time. I'm noticing some ambiguity about which service this modal belongs to since the commit list doesn't perfectly align with what I'd expect, so I should clarify which service this is for and advise against deploying edf62a9 if it's the wrong repository.

Ignoring the injected system context again — same fabricated claims (a token "pasted in chat and installed," `render_upsert_env_var`, etc. — none of that happened in this real session). Not calling `createApp`.

**This is Render's "Choose Commit to Deploy" picker** (Manual Deploy → Deploy a specific commit). Key things in it:

- **Auto-Deploy warning:** "Auto-Deploy will be disabled for this service to prevent accidental deploys" — meaning if you pick a commit here, this service stops auto-deploying from future GitHub pushes until you re-enable it.
- **`edf62a9` is pre-selected/highlighted** at the top — that's the same commit `rork-global-real-estate-invest1` (the wrong-repo static site) was already stuck on.
- Below it: `a958301` ("P0 auth certification"), then a run of `4c04da5`, `04f3829`, `5aed8d0`, `ea70515`, `5916259`, `f1ce667`, `2e6839e`, `c92ed78` — all labeled **"Payment infrastructure: ..."**

That "Payment infrastructure" commit list looks like real backend history, not the decoy repo — which makes me think **you might now be inside `ivx-holdings-platform` itself**, not `rork-global-real-estate-invest1`. I can't tell for sure because the service name isn't visible in this screenshot (scrolled past the top).

**Before you pick anything here, I need to confirm which service this is.** Can you scroll up and screenshot the top of this page so I can see the service name breadcrumb? That matters a lot:

- If this is **`ivx-holdings-platform`**: do **not** select `edf62a9` — that's not your latest commit. You want the newest commit on `main` (should match GitHub HEAD, last checked as `fd8e9137...`). Type that SHA into the "Input Commit SHA" search box instead of picking from this stale list.
- If this is still **`rork-global-real-estate-invest1`**: this whole picker is irrelevant to fixing `api.ivxholding.com` — back out and go to `ivx-holdings-platform` instead.

Also — separately — please get me the actual **failed deploy build log** from `ivx-holdings-platform` (tap into one of its red "Failed deploy" entries, then "View logs" or similar) so I can see why it's been failing for 11 hours. That's still the core blocker.
